name: Create Non Deliverable Forward Opening V 02
definition: Scope|The CreateNonDeliverableForwardOpening message is sent by a participant to a central system or to a counterparty to notify the opening of a non deliverable trade.|Usage|The trading parties will send similar messages to the central settlement system and the central settlement system will send notifications to both parties.

TradeInformation.name: Trade Information
TradeInformation.definition: Provides identification and date of the non deliverable trade which is created.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Specifies the trading side of the non deliverable trade which is created.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Specifies the counterparty of the non deliverable trade which is created.

TradeAmounts.name: Trade Amounts
TradeAmounts.definition: Specifies the amounts of the non deliverable trade which is created.

AgreedRate.name: Agreed Rate
AgreedRate.definition: Specifies the rate agreed at the opening of a non deliverable trade.

ValuationConditions.name: Valuation Conditions
ValuationConditions.definition: Specifies the valuation conditions of the non deliverable trade which is created.
